{{Quote|Do you think I'd let them kill me over a few lousy mansions on Herdessa?|Moff Tyrak|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Herdessa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. A peaceful world, many [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] and others of affluence could remain neutral in debates. It was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Shea Sadashassa/Legends|Shea Sadashassa]].

==History==
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the planet was part of the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]] of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Battle of Herdessa (Clone Wars)|Battle of Herdessa]] occurred six days after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

In the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was controlled by the [[Herdessan Guild]]. During a diplomatic mission to Herdessa with [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to overthrow the [[Herdessan Guild]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] first encountered a mysterious cyborg named [[Lumiya]].<ref name="SW66:F">[[Star Wars (1977) 88|''Star Wars'' (1977) 88]]</ref>
